subject: Post-call: MerchantX security checklist, evidence timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Javier Morales <javier.morales@merchantx.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@merchantx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MerchantX security checklist, evidence timeline & next steps

Hi Javier / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps:  

Key pain / goals you shared:
- Auditability: need searchable, exportable audit logs (7+ years retention requested by legal) for transaction metadata and API calls.
- Data residency & DPA expectations: MerchantX needs EU data residency for EU customers and a standard DPA plus custom clauses around deletion windows.
- SOC 2 alignment: current buying team requires evidence of SOC 2 controls and supporting artifacts for access control, change management, and incident response.
- Pen test: your security team asked about past pen-test scope and a summary of recent findings and mitigations.

What Redwood can provide (short):
- Audit logs: configurable retention, export (CSV/JSON) and S3 archival; we support 7 year retention with enterprise plan.
- DPA / legal: we can provide a standard DPA and support a limited set of negotiation points (redline path via DocuSign link below).
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can share a scope map and selected SOC 2 artifacts; we cannot publish full reports without an NDA but can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter and control evidence extracts.
- Pen-test summary: redacted executive summary of our latest pen-test + mitigation timeline; full reports on NDA.

Action items we agreed:
1) Marissa (me): share a DDQ/SOC2 evidence packet (initial artifacts) and a redacted pen-test summary by EOD Friday. Attachment: MerchantX_SOC2_DDQ_v1.pdf (preview).
2) MerchantX (Javier / Elena): confirm the exact retention window for EU customer logs and any encryption-at-rest KMS requirements by next Wednesday.
3) Ben: prepare an SLO/retention cost estimate for 7-year archive vs 1-year hot storage (cc'd).
4) Karthik: loop in our legal for DPA redline expectations and provide DocuSign link template.

Risk / open questions:
- If MerchantX requires on-prem key management (HSM), deployment model may move from Hosted to Dedicated or Private — this impacts timeline and cost.
- Pen-test full report requires NDA; please advise if you want us to route that via your procurement/legal team.

Next meeting suggestion: 30 min technical touchpoint with InfoSec + Platform (we propose Mon Apr 24 9:00-9:30 PT). Please confirm.

Attachments included (preview): MerchantX_SOC2_DDQ_v1.pdf
Doc links: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/MX-2028-042 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Note: files attached are redacted previews; full artifacts provided under NDA or controlled share.

From: Javier Morales <javier.morales@merchantx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@merchantx.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MerchantX security checklist, evidence timeline & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we heard. A few clarifications from our side:  

- Retention: MerchantX requires 7 years for EU merchant transaction logs and 3 years for US merchants. Is it possible to apply retention at a per-customer or per-tenant level so we can mix policies?
- KMS: For EU data we would prefer a KMS key stored in our cloud account (bring-your-own-key) — would that force Private deployment? Can you outline tradeoffs?
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can sign a company NDA to receive redacted control evidence. Please send the NDA template if possible.

Also, for the pen-test summary, could you include whether any high/critical items were open at the time of the review and if they were remediated? Our security team prioritizes unresolved critical findings.

Let's aim for the 24th meeting; 9:00 PT works for us.

Thanks,
Javier
Head of IT Security
MerchantX
javier.morales@merchantx.com

Marissa / Karthik —

I ran a quick cost sweep for the retention ask:
- 1 year hot + 6 years cold S3 archived (infrequent access) + log export tooling: est. incremental $2.1k/month for estimated 1.2 TB/year growth on their volume.
- Dedicated KMS/BYOK increases onboarding + monthly ops ~ $1.8k (engineering + key management).

I'll put a short one-pager for the 7-year vs 1-year TCO and note operational implications (e.g., e-discovery export times). Will attach by EOD.

Ben
